CONTROLS & SHORTCUTS

DRIVING CONTROLS:
W / Up Arrow : Throttle (Gas)
S / Down / Space : Brake
E : Shift Up Gear
Q : Shift Down Gear
C : Manual Clutch (Hold)
Enter : Start / Stop Engine
3D VIEW CONTROLS:
Left Mouse Drag : Orbit / Rotate 360°
Right Mouse Drag : Pan Camera
Mouse Wheel : Zoom In / Out
X Key : Explode / Collapse Internals
1-5 Keys : Quick Camera Views
Full simulation of 4-stroke combustion, high-pressure fuel rail & pump, dual-circuit radiator coolant flow, engine oil lubrication, spinning drivetrain & disc brake thermo-glow.
